result:
Completed the US March 2026 AP/expense review. Summary of actions taken:

**Fixed & posted:**
1. **Duplicate AP bill** — Stackline Cloud invoice STA-98877 was booked twice (JE-00232 & JE-00241, $31,148.20 each, same DOC-0160). Reversed JE-00241 via JE-00307 and submitted it for controller approval since it exceeds the $10k senior-accountant threshold.
2. **Miscoded invoice** — Northgate colocation bill (JE-00250, $3,880) was mislabeled "team dinner" and coded to Meals & Entertainment; reclassed to Hosting & Infrastructure via JE-00308 (under threshold, no approval needed).

**Flagged for controller (not force-posted):**
3. **EXC-001** — JE-00288 "Legal retainer" ($6,750) has zero support and none could be located; flagged rather than adjusted.
4. **EXC-002** — Zoom double-charged the card $149.90 on 3/8; confirmed via bank data both charges are real (not a ledger error), so left the entries alone and flagged for a vendor refund follow-up instead of reversing.

Checklist item "AP cutoff review" (US) marked complete, with the pending approval and two exceptions called out for the controller. Memo submitted.
